question: Who among the following is a famous Sitar player?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Imrat Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Imrat Khan was a renowned **Sitar and Surbahar player** from India.
 
• He belonged to the **Etawah Gharana** of music, which is a significant school for sitar and surbahar players.
 
• Imrat Khan was the younger brother of the famous sitar maestro **Ustad Vilayat Khan**.
 
• He performed globally, contributing to the spread of Indian classical music across the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sitar**

 
 
• The sitar is a plucked stringed instrument used mainly in Indian classical music.
 
• It is known for its deep, rich sound and is a prominent instrument in Hindustani classical music.
 
• Sitar has been popularized globally by musicians like Ravi Shankar and George Harrison of the Beatles.
 
 
 
• **Etawah Gharana**
 
 
• Also known as the Imdadkhani Gharana, it is one of the oldest schools of sitar and surbahar playing.
 
• It was founded by Imdad Khan, the grandfather of Imrat Khan.
 
• The Gharana is known for its intricate and expressive style of playing.
 
 
 
• **Sur Bahar**
 
 
• Sur Bahar is a plucked string instrument, similar to but larger than the sitar.
 
• It produces a deeper and more resonant sound compared to the sitar.
 
• It is often used in the dhrupad style of Indian classical music.
 
 
 
• **Ustad Vilayat Khan**
 
 
• He was an Indian classical sitar player and the elder brother of Imrat Khan.
 
• Vilayat Khan is considered one of the greatest sitar players of the 20th century.
 
• He contributed significantly to the modern sitar repertoire and technique.
